37:103.text: Then, when they had both submitted themselves
, and he had laid him prostrate on his forehead
(or on the side of his forehead for slaughtering)

37:104.text: We called out to him: "O Abraham!

37:105.text: You have fulfilled the dream!" Verily thus do We reward the Muhsinûn

37:106.text: Verily, that indeed was a manifest trial.

37:107.text: And We ransomed him with a great sacrifice

37:110.text: Thus indeed do We reward the Muhsinûn

37:111.text: Verily, he was one of Our believing slaves.

37:112.text: And We gave him the glad tidings of Ishâq

37:113.text: that do right, and some that plainly wrong themselves.

37:114.text: And, indeed We gave Our Grace to Mûsâ

37:115.text: And We saved them and their people from the great distress,

37:116.text: And helped them, so that they became the victors;

37:117.text: And We gave them the clear Scripture;

37:118.text: And guided them to the Right Path.

37:121.text: Verily, thus do We reward the Muhsinûn

37:122.text: Verily, they were two of Our believing slaves.

37:124.text: When he said to his people: "Will you not fear Allâh?

37:125.text: (a well known idol of his nation whom they used to worship)
and forsake the Best of creators,

37:126.text: "Allâh, your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers?"
